memory: The absolute certainty that things will inevitably work out. It represents the quiet, unquestioned optimism of childhood—a time before overthinking began to construct worst-case scenarios, when believing something would be okay was enough to make it true.
whyThisLine: It's not just an inspirational phrase; it's the emotional anchor of innocence. Repeating it actually felt like it could shape reality and protect against anything outside of your control.
